brand.name: Galing Gear
brand.tagline: For the storms, the quakes, and the gear that beats them.
brand.description: a Philippine emergency-preparedness and outdoor-gear site

audience.regionNotes: Philippine hazard context: the typhoon belt and habagat rains, floods in low-lying and metro areas, earthquakes and volcanic ashfall, brownouts and grid yellow/red alerts, and dry-season heat.
audience.readerPersona: A Filipino parent or renter preparing a household on a budget — for everyone under the roof, including children, lolos and lolas, PWDs, anyone on maintenance medication, and pets.

voice.persona: A trusted neighbour who has actually used the gear, telling you the truth over coffee — calm, plain, first-person, anti-hype, honest about what a product isn't.
voice.author: src/data/profile/author.md

seasonalCalendar.hook: Typhoon season — habagat rains, floods, landslides, leptospirosis after wading, power outages
Amihan and the holidays — fire and burns window (Christmas lights, cooking, firecrackers), holiday travel and stranded commuters
Fire Prevention Month; the hot, dry season begins
Dry-season heat — heat-index warnings, water interruptions, grid yellow and red alerts, brownouts
